donnees.titre: Hydrus® Microstent New Enrollment Post-Approval Study
donnees.titre_officiel: The Hydrus® Microstent New Enrollment Post-Approval Study: A Prospective, Non-Randomized, Multicenter, Single Arm, Clinical Trial

criteres_principaux.critere: Rate of occurrence of clinically significant device malposition associated with clinical sequelae
criteres_principaux.delai: Day 0 operative, up to Month 24 postoperative

donnees.resume_source: The purpose of this post-approval study is to evaluate the rate of Hydrus Microstent malposition and associated clinical sequelae occurring within 24 months post-operation. Qualified subjects will undergo uncomplicated cataract surgery with placement of a monofocal intraocular lens (IOL), followed by implantation of the Hydrus Microstent.

bras.description: Hydrus Microstent implanted in the eye immediately following cataract surgery and placement of a monofocal intraocular lens (IOL)
